list.title: Subsidiaries
list.subtitle: Live data from the TonyAI API
list.subtitleUser: Live data from the TonyAI API · {name} ({role})
list.empty: No subsidiaries accessible to your account.
list.deleteBody: This permanently removes the subsidiary and is recorded in the audit log. A subsidiary that still holds activity records, child companies, facilities, targets or closed reporting periods cannot be removed — deleting it would destroy them, and their evidence with them.

create.draftGeographyRequired: Choose a geography for the facility first.
create.title: Add subsidiary
create.locationsHint: A subsidiary's facilities are its reporting borders — add at least one. You can add more later on its page.
create.draftCap: A subsidiary can be created with at most {max} facilities. Add the rest from its page.
create.locationRequired: Add at least one operational facility

fields.geographyUnavailable: The geographies the factor library prices could not be read, so none can be chosen. Reload the page to try again.

detail.notFoundBody: This subsidiary does not exist, or you no longer have access to it.
detail.readOnly: You can view this subsidiary, but only a Masterkey can change it.
detail.loadFailed: This subsidiary could not be loaded.
detail.contactHint: Who to reach about this subsidiary's data — the person who prepares or coordinates the inventory, not whoever signs it off. Visible to everyone in this parent company, including an Auditor, and kept in the audit trail, so prefer a role mailbox over a personal number.

errors.forbidden: You do not have access to this subsidiary.
errors.unavailable: The service is unavailable right now.

geographyChange.title: Change geography from {from} to {to}?
geographyChange.body: Warning: Changing the geography will change the configured factor basis for geography dependent calculations. This may require recalculation of affected Scope 2 records for selected reporting periods. Do you want to continue?
geographyChange.subsidiaryNote: Records already committed keep the emission factor they were calculated with — those figures do not change. The new geography applies to records created from now on.
geographyChange.locationNote: Records already committed at this facility keep the emission factor they were calculated with — those figures do not change. The new geography applies to records created here from now on, and to any draft or returned record the next time it is saved.

dependents.title: What depends on this subsidiary
dependents.deletableNothing: Nothing depends on this subsidiary, so it can be deleted from the register.

blockers.terminalRecords: {count} approved, locked or voided activity record(s) belong to this subsidiary, and deleting it would permanently destroy them along with their evidence. Those records cannot be deleted at any point, so a subsidiary that has reported data stays. Set its status to "inactive" to retire it instead.
blockers.frozenBoundaryVersions: This subsidiary is declared in {count} confirmed or captured inventory boundary version(s), which record the inventory a report was issued from and never change, so a subsidiary declared in one stays. Set its status to "inactive" to retire it instead.
blockers.locationsHoldingForeignRecords: {count} facility(ies) holding a record that belongs to another subsidiary
blockers.openBoundaryVersions: {count} open inventory boundary version(s) declaring it

locations.empty: No facilities recorded for this subsidiary yet.
locations.name: Name *
locations.geographyHint: Drives the emission factor for records at this facility.
locations.readOnly: Only a Masterkey, or a Super Admin of this subsidiary, can add or modify facilities.
locations.deleteBody: This permanently removes the facility and is recorded in the audit log. A facility that activity records are attached to cannot be removed — those records would end up showing a different geography than the one they were calculated with.

locks.title: Period locks
locks.description: {name} — a locked period rejects any new, edited or submitted records (FR §4.2).
locks.empty: No locked periods — all reporting periods are open.
locks.hint: Committed records in the period flip to locked; unlocking reverts them to approved. Both actions are audited.
locks.readOnly: Only a Masterkey can lock or unlock reporting periods.
locks.locked: Locked {period} {year} — records in this period are now frozen

tree.associateClosed: Out of scope — data entry closed
tree.figuresFailed: The figures could not be loaded. The tree is shown without them.
tree.nonAuthoritativeMark: Not authoritative: {count} record(s) behind this figure rest on placeholder (demo) or other non-authoritative factors.
tree.nonAuthoritativeNote: Figures marked with a warning rest, in part, on placeholder (demo) or other non-authoritative factors, and so does every roll-up above them. They are not authoritative.
tree.uncalculatedMark: Incomplete: {count} record(s) behind this figure have no figure — no factor could price them.
tree.uncalculatedNote: Figures marked as incomplete leave out records no factor could price, and so does every roll-up above them; a zero so marked is not a measured zero.
tree.carriedOver: Created by the system, or before the group tree
tree.parentTop: None — the top of the tree you can read
tree.ghgBasisHint: Derived from the consolidation approach and the company’s control; it is not chosen.
tree.controlHint: Only a company with no records, user assignments, child companies or current boundary declaration can become an associate.
tree.naceInvalid: A NACE code reads like C, 10, 10.1 or C10.11.
tree.sharePercentHint: Optional. It enters no figure, total or roll-up.
tree.sharePercentInvalid: Enter a share from 0 to 100, with two decimals at most.
tree.moveHint: A company holding records anywhere beneath it does not move.
tree.typeFixed: A node’s type is fixed when it is created.
tree.noFacilitySectorGroup: A sector group is a label: it holds no facility.
tree.pricedOnly: Only geographies the factor library can price are offered.

consolidation.title: Consolidation approach
consolidation.hint: One approach for the whole group. A controlled company counts at 100 % under either approach; an associate is left outside Scope 1 and 2.
consolidation.loadFailed: The consolidation approach could not be loaded.

exclusions.title: Boundary exclusions
exclusions.item: {name} — outside Scope 1 and 2 as an associate
exclusions.itemShare: {name} ({share} %) — outside Scope 1 and 2 as an associate
exclusions.loadFailed: The boundary exclusions could not be loaded.
